variants.prompt:
Generate an ATMOSPHERIC GAME MAP DECORATION SPRITE SHEET with a genuinely transparent background. 2x2 grid, FOUR separate loosely suggested city prop silhouettes, generous completely transparent gutters between them. These are faint, blurry, half-seen ABSTRACT city impressions for the dark map in input 5, NOT inventory items, NOT detailed isometric props and NOT a whole background. Do NOT reproduce input5 map nodes, lines, text or UI. Input5 is only the darkness / atmosphere / visual hierarchy placement context. Inputs1-4 are painting grammar references only; no characters, costumes or weapons.
Critical user correction: earlier props were far too detailed. Paint each prop as TWO TO FIVE LARGE VAGUE SMUDGED SHADOW MASSES plus ONE OR TWO SOFT DIM LIGHT PATCHES. Their silhouettes are only partly visible, edges disappear into transparency and haze. Architecture is suggested, not described. No outlines, windows, panels, rivets, snow icicles, material texture, readable screens, wheels, warning symbols, tiny fragments, sharp detail or complete crisp shape. No explanatory lines. At thumbnail size the prop should read mostly as a vague industrial city memory touched by light; slight asymmetry in its blurred contour distinguishes it from generic fog. Painterly broad irregular shapes, not glossy 3D, not a vector icon, not photorealistic assets. Cold slate/charcoal tinted shadows, delicate translucent pale blue light and a sparse subdued warm lamp. Truly atmospheric and half transparent, subtle luminosity. No black rectangle, no checkerboard graphic, no environment landscape, no floor, no text, no interface. Keep all four clusters separate and fully within their quadrants. Diffuse haze is local to each object and dissolves entirely before the gutter.
Shared four subjects, recognizable only by the vaguest overall silhouette: top-left a tall thin urban lamp with a dim light smear; top-right an indistinct canopy/overhead transit structure with a single streak of light; bottom-left a low automated street fixture suggested by one squat dark mass and cyan smudge; bottom-right an ambiguous city infrastructure fragment, two vague uprights connected by a dim band. No perspective grid. Their purpose is quietly enriching the map's peripheral atmosphere, never competing with the bright encounter nodes.
